First public release of **PS5 Backport Toolkit** (formerly PS5 Backport Linux), now for Windows as well as Linux.

What it does: turns a decrypted PS5 game dump into a backport for older console firmware. It lowers
the SDK version, adds fakelibs taken from existing backports (kits), offers the known byte-level fixes
as tick-box rules with recommendations per game, and explains crash logs, either saved or captured
live from the console.

- **App** (`ps5bp-gui`) and **command line** (`ps5bp`) with the same features.
- **Windows 10/11** and **Linux** builds; the same game and kits give byte-identical output on both.
- Every build is verified byte by byte; overlays keep the originals and can be undone.

See the [README](https://github.com/cherryduck/ps5-backport-toolkit#readme) for a walkthrough.
